spec.prompt: Extreme close-up of the 'Globus' navigation instrument on the Voskhod-2 instrument panel (reference): a small metal-and-glass globe in a round window slowly rotating, brass meridian rings, a tiny crosshair marking the spacecraft's position, dials and toggle switches around it lit by warm panel lamps. Slow push-in. Photorealistic, shot on 35mm film, IMAX documentary realism in the spirit of Apollo 11 (2019) and Gravity. Accurate 1965 Soviet hardware: the white Berkut spacesuit with rust-orange harness straps, a white helmet with red CCCP letters above the visor, Soviet markings only. Hard directional sunlight, deep black space, crisp silhouettes. No on-screen text, no captions.
